fusions.name: Quick Nock
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tumbling Barrage
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Vine Swing
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds and your dodge chance by 8%. You blink 3 tiles when you use it, and it frees you of every root, freeze and slow.

fusions.name: Deft Re-Nock
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you restore 5 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
